formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : ℕ) (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),   (2 : ℕ) ≤ x1 →     PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x2 →       (∀ (x5 : Fin x1), ∃ (x6 : Fin x1 → Bool) (x7 : Fin x1 → Bool), (∀ (x8 : Fin x1), x8 ≠ x5 → x6 x8 = x7 x8) ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x1 x2 x6 ≠ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x1 x2 x7) →         ∃ (x6 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),           x6.size ≤ x2.size ∧             PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x6 ∧               PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x1 x6 = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x1 x2 ∧                 have x7 : List ℕ := List.flatMap (fun (x7 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) => List.take (bif x7.op.eval [Bool.false] then (1 : ℕ) else (2 : ℕ)) x7.inputs) x6.gates;                 (∀ x8 < x1 + x6.size, x8 ≠ x6.output → x8 ∈ x7) ∧ (List.filter (fun (x8 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) => x8.op.eval [Bool.false]) x6.gates).length + (x7.length - x7.toFinset.card) ≤ x6.size + (1 : ℕ) - x1
plain_statement: Any circuit of AND, OR (fan-in at most two) and NOT gates on n at least 2 inputs that depends on every input has an equivalent one, no larger, in which every wire except the output is read by some gate, and the number of NOT gates plus the number of repeated reads is at most size + 1 - n.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate OR(x_0, x_2) computes its edge function
